behavior: Shared Button exposes tooltip labels for icon-only controls; replaces native title tooltips.
Pointer hover includes disabled buttons; keyboard focus also shows the tooltip.
Escape, pointer down, pointer leave, focus loss and scrolling dismiss the tooltip with 200ms ease-out exit retention.
Placement flips below top-edge buttons, uses right placement for the side toolbar, and clamps to viewport edges.
Portal and manual popover preserve dialog accessibility and escape toolbar overflow/canvas transforms. Tooltip does not change image/button stacking or canvas scaling.
